subject.title: Slack: Show tool-level progress in assistant thread status

question: Should Slack native assistant-thread status show sanitized per-tool progress, and if so should that behavior be default-on or opt-in?
rationale: The source wiring gap is clear, but exposing active tool labels through Slack native status is a user-visible disclosure/default choice that overlaps existing Slack progress surfaces and the open Slack-safe visibility work.

options.title: Decide Policy First
options.body: Keep this issue open and settle the Slack progress-disclosure/default policy before accepting another per-tool native status implementation.

options.title: Implement Sanitized Native Status
options.body: Allow a narrow Slack-owned implementation that uses sanitized coarse labels, dedupes repeated writes, clears reliably, and includes live Slack proof.

options.title: Keep Native Status Generic
options.body: Close or narrow this request only if maintainers decide native Slack status should remain generic and progress detail belongs solely in existing preview/task/reaction surfaces.

recommendation.title: Decide Policy First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and settle the Slack progress-disclosure/default policy before accepting another per-tool native status implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest recent maintainer involvement in the adjacent Slack native-status loading-message decision and merge.
